label: ajito_honoo_010_sitappa_01
text: Whoa, whoa, you can’t be here. This base\nbelongs to Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_honoo_010_sitappa_02
text: If you don’t clear out real quick-like, I’ll hafta\ncome at you in self-defense. You get me?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_honoo_010_sitappa_03
text: Right answer, kid. Hasta la vistaaar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_honoo_010_sitappa_04
text: Well, all right! Time for me to self-defense the\nsnot right outta ya![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_honoo_010_sitappa_06
text: Wait... Are you that kid who declared war on\nTeam Star?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_honoo_010_sitappa_07
text: Whoa, thanks for the terrible news!\c\n’Scuse me while I book it back to the rest of\nmy crew![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_honoo_010_nelke_02
text: Cassiopeia told me to scope out the Fire\ncrew’s base.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_010_nelke_03
text: I thought I’d come give you some backup now\nthat I’m through, but seems you’re all set.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_010_nelke_06
text: I thought so! What are you doing here?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_010_select_06
text: Do you know this li’l fella?

label: ajito_honoo_010_nelke_08
text: He’s one of the Pokémon the academy takes\ncare of within its grounds.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_010_nelke_11
text:
It looks like he may have some connection to
Team Star’s Fire crew...\c
I’d better chase after him. Don’t worry—I’ll
regroup with you soon enough![VAR 0x0114(001E)]
